One day, after the program recording ends, Dapeng sees Qingqing is about to leave, he quickly goes over to talk to her. At this time, Bald Qiang also comes over.

[Question]
What does Dapeng want to do?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Asks Qingqing for her phone number.
B. Asks Qingqing to share her thoughts on today's program.
C. Invites Qingqing and Bald Qiang to have dinner together.
